# NGINX | F5
> NGINX provides application delivery, load balancing, ingress, API gateway, and web server technologies from F5.

NGINX.com is the primary product and documentation hub for NGINX Open Source, NGINX Plus, NGINX Ingress Controller, NGINX Gateway Fabric, NGINX Unit, and related learning, support, and community resources.

## Product Documentation
- [NGINX Documentation](https://docs.nginx.com/): Central documentation portal for NGINX products, deployment guides, and administration references.
- [NGINX Plus Admin Guide](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx/admin-guide/): Configuration and operations guidance for NGINX Plus load balancing and application delivery.
- [NGINX Ingress Controller Docs](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-ingress-controller/): Installation, configuration, and Kubernetes ingress management documentation.
- [NGINX Gateway Fabric Docs](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-gateway-fabric/): Documentation for deploying and operating NGINX Gateway Fabric with Kubernetes Gateway API.
- [NGINX Instance Manager Docs](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-instance-manager/): Guidance for fleet management, monitoring, and configuration of NGINX instances.
- [NGINX Unit Documentation](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-unit/): Docs for the polyglot application server and runtime configuration platform.
- [NGINX One Documentation](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-one/): Documentation for SaaS-based NGINX fleet visibility, management, and optimization.

## API Reference
- [NGINX Plus API](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx/admin-guide/monitoring/live-activity-monitoring/): Reference and usage guidance for monitoring and managing NGINX Plus runtime metrics.
- [NGINX Ingress Controller API Reference](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-ingress-controller/configuration/): Configuration reference for annotations, policies, and custom resources.
- [NGINX Gateway Fabric API Reference](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-gateway-fabric/): Gateway API-oriented resource and configuration documentation.
- [NGINX Instance Manager API Docs](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-instance-manager/): API and integration guidance for managing NGINX fleets programmatically.
- [NGINX Unit Control API](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-unit/configuration/): REST-based runtime configuration API for applications, listeners, and routes.

## Open Source Documentation
- [NGINX Open Source Docs](https://nginx.org/en/docs/): Official documentation for the open source NGINX web server and reverse proxy.
- [Beginner’s Guide](https://nginx.org/en/docs/beginners_guide.html): Introductory guide to configuration structure, control signals, and basic operation.
- [Admin Guide](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx/admin-guide/): Practical administration guidance applicable across common NGINX deployments.
- [Module Reference](https://nginx.org/en/docs/): Reference documentation for HTTP, stream, mail, and core modules.
- [Command-Line Parameters](https://nginx.org/en/docs/switches.html): Reference for startup options, configuration testing, and signal handling.
- [Development Guide](https://nginx.org/en/docs/dev/development_guide.html): Internal architecture and module development guidance for extending NGINX.

## Kubernetes and Cloud-Native
- [NGINX Ingress Controller](https://www.nginx.com/products/nginx-ingress-controller/): Product overview for Kubernetes ingress, traffic management, and security capabilities.
- [NGINX Ingress Controller Docs](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-ingress-controller/): Technical documentation for installation, configuration, and production operations.
- [NGINX Gateway Fabric](https://www.nginx.com/products/nginx-gateway-fabric/): Product information for Kubernetes Gateway API implementation by NGINX.
- [NGINX Gateway Fabric Docs](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-gateway-fabric/): Deployment and configuration guidance for Gateway API resources and policies.
- [Networking for Kubernetes](https://www.f5.com/solutions/networking-for-kubernetes): F5 solution page covering Kubernetes networking, ingress, and traffic management.
- [NGINX Kubernetes Labs](https://www.nginx.com/learn/): Learning resources covering Kubernetes ingress and cloud-native application delivery.

## Learning and Guides
- [NGINX Learn](https://www.nginx.com/learn/): Educational hub for articles, guides, and conceptual content about NGINX technologies.
- [NGINX Blog](https://www.nginx.com/blog/): Product updates, technical tutorials, release news, and best practices.
- [Webinars](https://www.nginx.com/resources/webinars/): On-demand and upcoming webinars on NGINX deployment and operations topics.
- [Ebooks](https://www.nginx.com/resources/library/): Downloadable technical resources, reports, and solution-oriented guides.
- [Customer Stories](https://www.nginx.com/customers/): Case studies showing how organizations use NGINX in production.
- [Events](https://www.nginx.com/events/): Conferences, community events, and training-related event listings.

## Downloads and Trials
- [Download NGINX Open Source](https://nginx.org/en/download.html): Source and package download information for open source NGINX releases.
- [Free Trial of NGINX Plus](https://www.nginx.com/free-trial-request/): Trial request page for evaluating NGINX Plus in production-like environments.
- [NGINX Open Source Packages](https://nginx.org/packages/): Official package repositories and installation instructions for supported platforms.
- [NGINX Unit Install](https://unit.nginx.org/installation/): Installation instructions for NGINX Unit across operating systems and distributions.
- [NGINX Agent and Management Docs](https://docs.nginx.com/nginx-instance-manager/): Setup guidance for managed visibility and control of NGINX instances.
